I regret to express my opposition to this proposal. Whilst many would like to begin trading of COW as soon as possible I think we have other priorities.
Firstly we do not yet have an agreed upon Governance mechanism. This takes time and consideration to put together.
Secondly we have yet to decide on any value capture mechanics (tokenomics).
These two concerns are on top of what has been mentioned in terms of the claim period.
It is a given that we will make this decision eventually but launching without a clear way forward could present the danger of too many sellers without value buyers coming in.

Thanks
@indiana
. You raise lots of interesting points. I suspect that in order to prove that this is truly a community owned DAO everything has to be proposed and agreed upon by the community.
In regards to trading it’s more like a chicken and egg scenario. Trading $COW tokens is not possible unless it is redeemed (vCOW → $COW). Upon redemption there needs to be an underlying liquidity pool for traders to use if we want $COW to have any appreciable value. In order to facilitate this, we should encourage Liquidity Providers (LP) to take on risk providing the necessary liquidity (COW<>ETH/WETH/USDC Pools, etc) by compensating them with $COW tokens. This is why I suggested the following CIP to compensate LP’s in order to jump start this process.
CIP-draft: Should CowDAO Distribute $COW to Liquidity Providers?
People also want to see utility, which may drive demand for the token and incentivize trade. This is why the following two CIPs were raised. Please see:
CIP-draft: Trading Fee discount for $COW holders
CIP-draft: CowSwap Grants Program (CGP)
I believe it is in the interest of the DAO to iron out these details prior to $COW redemption, to give it a good start.

netrunner.eth:
Trading $COW tokens is not possible unless it is redeemed (vCOW → $COW). Upon redemption there needs to be an underlying liquidity pool for traders to use if we want $COW to have any appreciable value.
We don’t know if this is an issue at all… don’t forget -
GIP-13 (Phase 2): CowDAO and COW Token
It is expected that not all options will be leveraged. The COW Tokens that are earmarked for investment options but not leveraged, will be used for liquidity incentives of the respective token pairs: COW tokens not bought by GNO Token Holders will be used to incentivize a COW<>GNO pool; COW tokens not bought by Cow Protocol Traders will be used to incentivize a COW<>ETH pool.
So far many claimed the airdrop and didn’t use their investment option. If we keep this ratio, we may end up with more than 20m unclaimed vCow for liquidity incentives meaning we may not need more incentives.
